calibration.formula: omega_offset = median(Omega[:30]) - 0.05; Omega_cal = clip(Omega - offset, 0, None)

loso_holdout_validation.note: Leave-One-Scenario-Out: Youden τ fit on 3 train scenarios only; held-out scored with Tier-1 5-beat gasket and 180 s tactical horizon. Per-session Omega_cal re-anchor uses only that session's first 30 beats.

osd575_cohort_metrics.note: OSD-575 consists of discrete blood-draw timepoints (not continuous ECG).
